summary: Full E2E retest on web preview https://ignite-nutrition.preview.emergentagent.com using the corrected testIDs from the review_request. All 10 listed flows pass end-to-end: landing brand 'IGNITE' renders → cta-get-started opens auth sheet → tab-signup → input-name/email/password filled → btn-auth-submit redirects to /onboarding → all 5 onboarding steps (age 30/height 178/weight 75 → male → muscle_gain → Omnivore → Nuts) reach /dashboard → 'DAILY TARGET 2704 kcal' visible with all 4 quick-action cards (action-meal-plan/scan/chat/recipe) → meal plan generated within ~25s and 4 meal cards rendered (Greek yogurt parfait, Grilled chicken, etc.) → log-breakfast tapped → AI chat ('list 3 high-protein snacks') returned a Mercury-2 reply with detailed snack list within ~20s → feed open-upload modal accepted 'E2E Power Bowl' recipe and it appeared in the community list → profile screen opened from header-profile and profile-save returned to dashboard. Backend confirmed working from prior iteration (15/15). Frontend success rate: 100% on the 10 scripted steps. Minor: my Playwright click on the bottom 'PROGRESS' tab via text selector did not navigate (URL remained /feed) so the dedicated progress screen entry was not visually re-asserted, but the breakfast log API call succeeded (no error, dashboard state consistent) and Mercury-2 chat result image confirms the AI tab works.
